description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Sri Lanka Export Development Act No. 40 of 1979. Order under Section 14
reasoning: This gazette notification is an Order issued under Section 14 of the Sri Lanka Export Development Act, No. 40 of 1979. It amends a previous gazette notification by inserting a new paragraph that establishes regulatory procedures and compliance requirements for the importation of essential goods received as aid/donations. The content focuses entirely on creating a legal/regulatory framework for customs exemptions and handling of donated goods, including conditions, approval processes, accountability measures, and enforcement provisions under the Customs Ordinance for violations. While it names the Minister who issued the order, it does not describe his portfolio responsibilities in detail, and the primary purpose is regulatory rather than about government personnel or structure.
